name: api-orchestrator-monorepo
description: Monorepo for api-orchestrator - A production-ready API infrastructure toolkit

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@api-orchestrator/core && npm run build --workspace=@api-orchestrator/react
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@api-orchestrator/core && npm run test --workspace=@api-orchestrator/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@api-orchestrator/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@api-orchestrator/react
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd packages/core && npm pack && cd ../react && npm pack
scripts.pack:check: npm run pack && tar -tzf packages/core/api-orchestrator-*.tgz | head -50
